coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Full Stack Developer position at OpenBrand. My background combines software development, systems integration, production migration, and client implementation support. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, with project management responsibilities. That combination is relevant to OpenBrand’s Comperemedia integration and its need for engineers who can connect implementation work with delivery coordination.

Two examples illustrate the experience I would bring. First, at DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadened support for tax providers and financial platforms, and improved UI/UX. My integration work includes platforms such as Acumatica, Chargebee, and Sage Intacct, alongside support for requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live. I also managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates and status and creating guides and knowledge-base articles. These responsibilities connect directly to the implementation and communication demands of a multi-system integration. Second, I migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. My work at DSTax also included optimizing asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput. This provides relevant production migration and application-performance experience for OpenBrand’s cloud modernization work, while the specific services and migration paths in your environment would require further ramp-up.

I remain interested in the opportunity to contribute to OpenBrand’s integration and modernization effort. The role’s combination of platform development, cloud migration, and direct coordination around delivery milestones offers a clear connection to the work I have undertaken at DSTax. I would welcome a conversation about how that experience could support your team’s priorities. Thank you for considering my application.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized integration ownership, platform modernization, AWS migration, asynchronous performance improvements, implementation support, and delivery communication. Retained relevant Python, infrastructure, database, and AI-tool skills. The master does not establish React, TypeScript, Node.js, named AWS-service depth, large-scale cloud integrations with professional references, or five years specifically spanning full stack engineering. Daily agentic workflows, multiple-agent operation, AI-spend reporting, MCP, and the specified data-pipeline migrations are undocumented. Regular Chicago-area availability is unconfirmed.
